messages.subject: Trouble with AmazonS3 access options
parts:
I am having trouble setting and using the AmazonS3 options. I installed the RAmazonS3 package. As per the documentation i should be able to set options as options(AmazonS3 = c('login' = "secret")). I used my Access Key Id in place of login and Secret Access Key in place of secret. However when i run listBuckets() I get an error - Error in system(cmd, intern = TRUE) : 'perl' not found.

Has anyone faced a similar issue? if so, please suggest how it was resolved.

thanks
Abhey
